summary.text: Jennifer Jenkins is the Democratic nominee for Florida's 8th Congressional District. A speech-language pathologist and former Brevard Public Schools board member, she briefly sought the 2026 U.S. Senate special election before running for this House seat. In her candidate survey she describes a career in public education and campaigns on housing affordability, including homeowners insurance costs.

paragraphs.text: Describes herself as the daughter of a corrections officer and a mother who became disabled when Jenkins was young, raised in a working-class family.
Earned a bachelor's degree from Florida Atlantic University in 2009 and a graduate degree from the University of Central Florida in 2014.
Worked as a speech-language pathologist; says she built her career in public education working with children and families, particularly students with disabilities and developmental needs.
Elected to the Brevard Public Schools school board, District 3, in 2020, defeating incumbent Tina Descovich; served from November 2020 to November 2024 and did not seek re-election.
Also filed to run in the 2026 U.S. Senate special election in Florida before running for this U.S. House seat; she did not appear on the special Democratic primary ballot.
Says her husband is a public school teacher and their daughter attends Brevard Public Schools.
